label: prop:joint-galois-braid-figure-8-verified
title: Joint Galois $\times$ braid action commutes on the figure-8 bi-filtration cell — verified directly
html:
The joint motivic-Galois \times braid-group action conjecture (conj:joint-galois-braid-action) predicts commutativity on each \mathcal{H}_q^{(n, K)} stratum. We verify this prediction on the figure-8 row \mathcal{H}_q^{(2, 4_1)} by direct computation.

The figure-8 bi-filtration cell is \mathcal{H}_q^{(2, 4_1)} \subseteq G^{(2)}(\mathcal{H}_q), with dominant cell \lambda_K = (2, 2) in H_4(q) and shape parameter z_K = \zeta_6 = e^{i\pi/3}.

The two group actions:

  • G_{\mathrm{mot}} \supseteq \langle * \rangle (bar): *: q \mapsto q^{-1}, \zeta_6 \mapsto \zeta_6^{-1}.
  • B_4 \to H_4(q): \sigma_1, \sigma_2, \sigma_3 act by conjugation in H_4(q), fixing central idempotents.
